system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Project Kestrel — buyer-side review

The Seller’s **[STANDARD]** labels and reviewer note are not evidence that Wattlebridge accepted or cleared those provisions. They should be reviewed and negotiated against the agreed AUD 24 million, debt-free/cash-free transaction.

| Issue | Seller’s position | What the Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | General warranty claims capped at **20% of price (AUD 4.8m)**. | A higher general warranty cap, with separate, higher caps for fundamental warranties and appropriate treatment of indemnities, tax and fraud. | **Counter with a higher cap**, subject to the overall risk package; AUD 4.8m may leave a significant loss uninsured. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | Claims must exceed **AUD 25,000** individually and, in aggregate, **AUD 250,000**; only the excess over the basket is recoverable. | Lower thresholds, aggregation of related claims, and a tipping basket under which the whole qualifying amount is recoverable once the threshold is crossed. | **Counter on both thresholds and basket structure**; the Seller’s deductible basket shifts the first AUD 250,000 of qualifying loss to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | General warranty claims must be notified within **18 months after Completion**, with limitations applying to all claims unless expressly excepted. | A longer general warranty notification period, preferably **24 months**, and separate periods for tax, title and other categories. | **Seek 24 months and express category-specific periods**; 18 months may not cover two full financial reporting cycles. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties receive the same cap and time limit as general warranties. | Fundamental warranties subject to a cap up to the **purchase price** and a substantially longer period, aligned with the applicable statutory limitation period; no general de minimis or basket. | **Reject the general regime for fundamental warranties**; ownership and authority are foundational to the acquisition. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to **all claims of any nature**; no fraud exception is stated. | An express fraud carve-out from caps, thresholds, time limits, disclosure and knowledge limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions, preserving remedies available at law. | **Insert an express, consistently drafted fraud carve-out**; the current blanket language risks restricting recourse for deliberate wrongdoing. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | General disclosure of the entire data room, Accounts, statutory registers and public records, plus specific disclosures. | Only **fairly disclosed** matters, with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope, against the relevant warranty; reject blanket data-room and public-record disclosure. | **Replace general disclosure with a fair-disclosure standard**; document availability alone does not necessarily reveal a particular risk. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for matters known to Buyer or advisers, including matters **discoverable** in the data room or public records. | Delete the discoverability and adviser-knowledge exclusion; if a qualifier is unavoidable, limit it to actual knowledge of named Buyer personnel, with appropriate fraud and indemnity carve-outs. | **Delete or narrowly confine clause 8.3**; constructive knowledge could extinguish claims for risks Buyer did not actually identify. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Seller will use reasonable endeavours; consent condition treated as satisfied on written consent. DD-002 indicates conditions in clause 11.3; no final consent or evidence of satisfaction is supplied. | A completion condition requiring a valid written consent **and satisfaction or waiver of its associated conditions**, without unacceptable adverse changes; access to the full consent and evidence. | **Make satisfactory consent and associated conditions a condition precedent**, with a long-stop and termination right; written consent alone may not secure continuity of a customer representing approximately 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately **AUD 3.2m** outstanding; release proposed after Completion. No repayment or final security discharge is included. | Repayment at Completion from Seller proceeds, verified payout figure, enforceable release arrangements and discharge of all security, consistent with debt-free/cash-free pricing. | **Require simultaneous repayment and release at Completion**; a post-Completion promise leaves Buyer exposed to debt and encumbrances. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | Conditional Completion bonuses total **AUD 420,000** and are omitted from the funds flow; applicable on-costs are unknown. | Determine which bonuses vest and who bears them, including payroll tax, superannuation and other applicable on-costs; reflect agreed Seller-funded amounts in the funds flow or price adjustment without double counting. | **Resolve and document the liability and funding before Completion**; otherwise the Company may bear a Seller-related transaction cost after acquisition. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Existing indemnity is limited to the specific SOW3 payment; DD-010 shows AUD 180,000 open, but non-payment is not independently verified. No receipt or confirmatory assignment is supplied. | Verify payment; obtain cleared-payment evidence and a confirmatory assignment or licence covering the relevant Project Materials, plus an indemnity for resulting losses and costs if the risk remains. | **Obtain documentary cure before Completion and broaden the indemnity**; the exposure may extend beyond the fee to ownership, use and remediation of IP. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Described as preliminary and not expected to be material. A link went to an unintended external address; access, scope, notification requirements and loss remain unconfirmed. | Complete targeted investigation, preserve evidence, assess applicable notification obligations with privacy counsel, obtain status and remediation details, and agree a specific indemnity if the exposure cannot be resolved. | **Investigate and allocate the identified risk before signing or Completion**; uncertainty is not proof either of a breach or of immateriality. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Three renewals totalling **AUD 330,000** described as ordinary-course operating costs. Their timing, accrual, avoidability and termination rights are not established. | Review DD-008 and DD-011 together and the underlying contracts; establish timing, liability and value, then allocate any pre-Completion or non-ordinary-course amount through the agreed price mechanism or a specific adjustment. | **Verify before accepting Seller’s characterisation**; the current record does not establish whether the costs are unavoidable or ordinary course. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | Limitations apply to all claims unless expressly stated otherwise; exclusive remedy and non-reliance also apply broadly. | Separate, expressly drafted regimes for general and fundamental warranties, tax, specific indemnities, purchase-price/debt adjustments and fraud, including caps, thresholds and periods appropriate to each. | **Add a claims-category and precedence schedule**; blanket limitations can unintentionally undermine negotiated protections and the debt-free/cash-free adjustment. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | DD-012 share register records Harbourglass as holder of 100% of issued shares. | Verify the register and corporate records, issued capital and any options or convertible rights; obtain title and capacity warranties, executed transfers, releases of encumbrances and completion evidence of registration. | **Verify title independently and require clean transfer deliverables**; the register is useful evidence but does not by itself resolve every ownership or encumbrance question. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Seller regards tax and IP warranties as settled under the general regime. | Reopen tax and IP scope and limitations: seek a tax covenant or indemnity for pre-Completion tax with an appropriate longer claim period; comprehensive IP ownership, use and infringement warranties, with specific protection for identified risks. | **Treat tax and IP as open**; general warranties subject to a 20% cap and 18-month limit may not adequately address these exposures. |

**Priority before committing:** resolve Bluefen and Riverlark as Completion protections; establish the bonus and renewal economics; investigate the export incident and cure the Ironquay IP position. The complete SPA, underlying due diligence and applicable claim-limitation rules should be checked when drafting the exceptions and mechanics.
=== END ADVICE ===
